name: Pimoroni Tiny 2040
description: Postage-stamp (23x18 mm) RP2040 with USB-C, 8 MB flash (2 MB option), RGB LED and castellated pads for soldering into wearables and small builds.
notes: Only 12 pads: 8 GPIO (GP0-GP7) plus 4 ADC-capable (GP26-GP29), 3V3, GND, VBUS.
RGB LED is active-low; BOOT switch on GP23 doubles as a user button.
Sold as 8 MB (about $10), 8 MB with pre-soldered headers, or 2 MB (about $9); frequently out of stock - Tiny 2350 is the successor.
Input 3-5.5 V, 3V3 regulator limited to about 300 mA.
